subject.title: Improve Control UI Lit state ownership

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102848 as the implementation path for this maintainer-labeled Control UI state-ownership follow-up?
rationale: The issue is protected by the `maintainer` label and already has a same-topic closing PR, so automation should not close it or queue a duplicate fix branch before maintainer review of that candidate.
